rows.title: Dollars or shares parse exactly
rows.test: a bare integer next to a symbol asks whether it is dollars or shares

rows.title: The symbol resolves against real instruments
rows.defect: a single name match is treated as the exact instrument
rows.test: a name match asks "did you mean" instead of trading on it

rows.title: Decision words are refused, direction is obeyed
rows.defect: only the advice guard's shapes are refused; an order that leaves the pick to the agent goes through
rows.test: "whatever is best" and "the stock that just dipped" are refused

rows.title: A real quote prices the estimate, or nothing does
rows.defect: a stale quote prices the order
rows.test: a 20-minute-old quote asks to refresh and shows no number

rows.title: The account is chosen, never assumed
rows.defect: with several accounts the first one is used silently

rows.title: Buying power is read before asking for a yes
rows.test: $320 settled against a $500 order stops with the shortfall

rows.title: The confirmation restates the exact order
rows.defect: the confirmation drops the quote's source and time
rows.test: the confirmation names the quote source and as-of

rows.title: No partner, no order
rows.defect: the compliance gate is not wired into the loop
rows.test: without a broker-dealer partner the request is blocked

rows.title: Nothing before yes; a stale yes is nothing
rows.defect: the loop accepts an approval after it expired
rows.test: a yes eleven minutes later is refused

rows.title: "Yes but" corrects and re-quotes
rows.defect: the correction keeps the old amount

rows.title: Market closed means queued, said plainly
rows.defect: the market is treated as always open
rows.test: on a Saturday the confirmation says queued and the receipt says queued

rows.title: A fill is read back, not assumed
rows.defect: the receipt reports the estimate as the fill
rows.test: the receipt's total is the broker's fill, not the estimate

rows.title: The same order is not placed twice
rows.defect: the idempotency key carries the exact time, so every repeat is a new order
rows.test: the same text twice answers already placed

rows.title: Rail failure is unknown or failed, never done
rows.defect: the loop retries a write that threw, placing the order twice
rows.test: a write that throws is not retried

rows.title: The receipt and the memory tell the truth
rows.defect: the written params drop the amount, so the outcome has none
rows.test: the memory outcome records the amount

rows.title: Stop-on-change
rows.defect: the re-verification result is ignored, so a moved price still places the order
rows.test: a price, fee, cash or session move between yes and order stops it
